title: Scratch Assay Protocol
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.izucf6w

steps.title: Mark the 24-well plate
steps.instruction: Use a marker pen to draw a “十” glyph medially on the back of the 24-well plate.

steps.title: Create the scratch
steps.instruction: 24 hours after the up-regulation and down-regulation of Nrf2, create scratches along the “十” mark using a 10-ul pipette tip, ensuring the tip remains vertical and not tilted.

steps.title: Wash and add medium
steps.instruction: Wash the 24-well plate three times with PBS, then add 1ml of serum-free medium to the plate.

steps.title: Incubate and measure scratch spacing
steps.instruction: Culture the 24-well plates in a 37-degree, 5% CO2 incubator and measure the scratch spacing at 0, 24, and 48 hours of culture.
